shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and event-driven work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics, with documented deviations: floor removal only drops things when the exposed terrain is open air; bomb-punched rooftop holes deferred.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; sync handlers shut down on error, renderer fails open to opaque-below.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T1.3)
- Core (T0): LevelComp registry on pocket maps aligned 1:1, ground comp as column controller, parent.Tile set for real day/night + geology; stairs pairs that generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains (GenStep_ABSkyTerrain): solid mass = mineable edifice or thick natural roof below, contracted one cell: outer ring = open walkable rock ledge (unroofed, lit, unfogged); eroded core = mineable rock walls under thick rock roof; fog covers only cells two erosions deep, leaving two visible rock face rows outside the fog falloff (vanilla mountain read). Thin-roof overhang strip and unroofed cells = open air; constructed roofs below = buildable rooftop terrain (texture brightened for readability). Map-edge masses stay solid to the border.
- See-below renderer (Harmony): MapDrawer.DrawMapMesh prefix draws the surface map's cached section submeshes at y=-2.5 under the sky map, dim quad at y=-0.25 (0-80% setting); DynamicDrawManager postfix re-runs the surface map's dynamic draw under a global DrawPos offset flag for live pawns/projectiles (toggleable). Camera far clip raised 65.5 -> 70.
- Live sync (LevelSync via vanilla MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above live (with floor collapse on support loss); sky floors write constructed roofs below; anything over open air falls through with Z-Levels-style consequences.
- Stairs landings mine out their 3x3 on any destination level, convert air to rooftop, and unfog.

## Quadruple pass log
T1 reentrancy verified; T1.1 far clip 92%, alignment 90%, landing 92%; T1.2 contraction 90%; T1.3 fog band 90%. Known quirks / polish backlog: below-view renders full-bright + fixed dim (ignores surface time-of-day, so the sky level can read darker than the world below at dusk); lower pawns' far-zoom silhouettes can draw over sky terrain; water-depth submeshes below may look flat; natural-roof removal under sky mountains not yet handled; bomb holes in rooftops deferred.

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE, T1 through T1.3 CODE DONE (T1.3 awaiting in-game verification).
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3 (next after T1 sign-off, user-requested): cross-map stockpiles/hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature/weather sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish (below lighting consistency, bomb holes, below glow, water depth).

## Status
T1.3 compiled green, pushed. Pending in-game verification: two visible rock face rows outside the fog on a fresh sky level.
